markets.rules_primary: If ARI Cardinals D/ST scores at least 1+ touchdowns in the Denver vs Arizona Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 25, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to ARI Cardinals D/ST in the Denver vs Arizona Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 25, 2026. If ARI Cardinals D/ST is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the fair market price before game start. Once ARI Cardinals D/ST takes at least one snap, even if nullified by penalty, the market settles based on touchdowns scored. Touchdowns scored on fake punts or field goals by the offensive team do not count as a special teams touchdown.
